caveats.text: The ON_TARGET call rests on a neighbour-competition margin of just 0.089 px (dimming centroid 0.584 px from target vs 0.673 px from the nearest bright-enough neighbour) - inside diag_pixel.py's own stated centroid systematic of 0.10-0.3 px. TESS's resolution cannot confidently separate this star from that neighbour.
